create.name: Matthew Cohen
create.bio:
Matthew Cohen, known to students as Sifu Matthew, is a qigong, yoga and martial arts teacher and the creator of Sacred Energy Arts, a practice that weaves the three traditions together. He started yoga as a small child and martial arts at twelve, training over the years in Shaolin kung fu, tai chi, boxing and wrestling. After a serious accident in 1988 he turned to bodywork, acupuncture, qigong and other energy practices, studied with many teachers, and for a long time combined teaching with work as a manual therapist.

Sacred Energy Arts brings slow qigong forms, breath training, yoga flow and martial discipline together with meditation, poetry and time in nature, with the aim of building vitality, steadiness and a felt connection to life. He teaches weekly online qigong and breath classes, occasional longer online workshops such as Five Elements qigong, and an in-person Yoga and Qigong Flow class at Yoga Soup in Santa Barbara, and he works privately with individuals, including actors, athletes and business leaders. Interviews he gave for The Shift Network's Qigong Global Summit are shared on his website.

courses.title: Weekly Qigong Class (Zoom)
courses.description: A one-hour online class each Thursday covering posture, breathing, standing practice, meditation and visualisation, and movements for mobility and strength, drawn from Matthew's lifetime of qigong practice.

courses.title: Breath Inside the Breath (Zoom)
courses.description: A weekly online hour on Wednesdays combining guided breathing, gentle movement and stillness to explore the subtler layers of the breath and build relaxation and self-awareness.

courses.title: Five Elements Qigong
courses.description: A 90-minute online workshop teaching a sequence of slow, circling five-element movements, each linked to one of the elements in Chinese tradition, for a sense of calm and balance.

courses.title: Yoga & Qigong Flow at Yoga Soup
courses.description: A weekly in-person Monday class in Santa Barbara that blends vinyasa yoga with qigong energy work, breath and meditation, at a steady pace suitable for beginners and intermediate students.

courses.title: Private Sessions with Matthew
courses.description: One-to-one training in Sacred Energy Arts, drawing on yoga, martial arts, qigong and tai chi and shaped around the student's own goals. Rates on enquiry.
